verdict: Instagram ads are profitable this period, returning about $5 for every $1 spent on $4,087 in spend.
diagnosis: 607 purchases generated $21,056 in sales, but only 108 tracked through the pixel, suggesting attribution gaps hiding true performance.

signals.headline: Return on ad spend hit 5.1x
signals.detail: $21,056 in sales on $4,087 spend beats the healthy 3-to-5x band for direct-to-consumer food brands.

signals.headline: 607 purchases at $6.73 each
signals.detail: Cost per purchase sits well below typical meat category acquisition costs. Lamb Escalopes video is doing the heavy lifting.

signals.headline: 433 add-to-carts, 163 checkouts started
signals.detail: Roughly 38% of carts reach checkout. A meaningful share of interested buyers drop before paying.

signals.headline: 273 reviews averaging near 5 stars
signals.detail: Strong local reputation this period. Trust signals are working but underused in paid creative.

signals.headline: 182 new Instagram followers added
signals.detail: Modest organic follower growth on a 6,691 base. Paid reach is not translating into audience building.

recommendations.title: Fix pixel tracking to close attribution gap
recommendations.detail: Only 108 of 607 purchases fired through the Meta pixel. Consider auditing the pixel setup so reporting matches actual sales and the algorithm optimizes correctly.

recommendations.title: Test scaling budget on Lamb Escalopes video
recommendations.detail: The winning ad is producing sales at $6.73 each. Worth testing a 25-50% budget lift while watching frequency, currently at 1.32, for fatigue.

recommendations.title: Add checkout recovery flow for dropped carts
recommendations.detail: 270 shoppers added to cart but never started checkout. Consider testing an email or SMS reminder sequence to recover a share of that lost revenue.
